fullDescription: Playful candy-pastel bento card-library landing page ('Cardstack — Beautiful cards, snapped into place') on a warm cream canvas: a sticky cream glass nav, a centered hero with a sunny highlighter headline and rotated floating sticker chips, and a colorful bento grid whose 2x2 deep-sky gradient feature card (with a nested mini-bento preview) anchors sunny stat, coral quote, white mini-stat and ink CTA cards, plus a How-it-works band, a gradient-header kit grid, and an ink-gradient pricing banner. Cream + sky + coral + sunny + ink, set in Poppins with Phosphor icons; cards wiggle and tilt on hover.

structured.summary: A playful, candy-pastel bento card-library landing page ('Cardstack — Beautiful cards, snapped into place') built around a colorful bento grid of card variants on a warm cream canvas. A sticky translucent cream glass nav sits above a centered hero (a 'NEW' pill, a big two-line headline with a sunny highlighter swipe under 'snapped into place', a subhead, two pill CTAs, and two rotated floating 'sticker' chips), then the signature bento gallery: a 3-column grid whose first card is a 2x2 deep-sky gradient 'Featured kit' tile holding a mini 3-column bento preview (a bar-chart tile, a sunny +38% stat tile, a coral rating tile, a label strip), beside a sunny stat card (25,000+ with an avatar stack) and a coral quote card; then a second 4-column row (two white mini-stat cards + a 2-col ink CTA tile). Below: a white 'How it works' band (three numbered cream step cards), a 'Starter kits' section (a 4-up grid of gradient-header kit cards), a big rounded ink gradient pricing/CTA banner with blurred color blobs, and a footer. Cards lift and tilt on hover. The palette is cream + sky + coral + sunny + ink, set in Poppins, with Phosphor icons.

style.description: Playful, friendly, candy-pastel bento aesthetic on a warm cream canvas (#fdf9f3) with a faint dot 'grain' texture. The accent system is a small bright quartet: sky blue (#38bdf8, deep #0876b8), coral/rose (#fb7185, deep #d83b56), sunny yellow (#ffc23c, with an amber-ink #a86a00 for text on yellow), all anchored by a soft near-black plum 'ink' (#2a2438) used for headings, the dark nav mark, dark cards, and the dark CTA bands. Everything is built from big friendly rounded-[28px]/[36px] cards, full-pill buttons and chips, generous padding, and two soft layered shadows (soft = 0 18px 40px -18px rgba(42,36,56,0.22), lift = 0 26px 60px -22px rgba(42,36,56,0.30)). Surfaces are either white/cream with a faint 8% ink border, a saturated solid color (sunny / coralDeep), a deep-sky-to-#065d91 gradient, or an ink gradient. Type is one rounded geometric typeface, Poppins (400-800), with heavy extrabold (800) tracking-tight headings and a hand-drawn touch: a sunny/70 highlighter bar swiped behind a headline phrase. Big blurred color blobs (sky/coral/sunny at 15-20% behind blur-3xl) float in the hero and CTA banner. Icons are Phosphor (ph:*-fill / -bold) via Iconify. Cards 'wiggle' on hover: translateY(-6px) + a -1deg rotate via a springy cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1); buttons nudge up 0.5 on hover.
style.prompt: Build a playful, candy-pastel bento card-library landing page on a warm cream canvas, all rounded and friendly. Load Poppins (weights 400/500/600/700/800) from Google Fonts as the only typeface. Configure a Tailwind palette: cream #fdf9f3, sky #38bdf8, skyDeep #0876b8, coral #fb7185, coralDeep #d83b56, sunny #ffc23c, amberInk #a86a00 (for text on yellow), ink #2a2438. Define two shadows: soft = 0 18px 40px -18px rgba(42,36,56,0.22) and lift = 0 26px 60px -22px rgba(42,36,56,0.30). Body is bg-cream, text ink, font Poppins, antialiased; html scroll-behavior smooth. Add a '.grain' texture (radial-gradient circle at 1px 1px, rgba(42,36,56,0.05) 1px dots on a 22px tile) for the hero and CTA banner. Cards use very round corners (rounded-[28px], banners rounded-[36px]); buttons and chips are full pills (rounded-full). Headings are Poppins extrabold (800) tracking-tight; one headline phrase gets a hand-drawn sunny/70 highlighter bar (an absolute h-3.5 full-width bg-sunny/70 rounded-sm sitting behind the text at bottom-1.5). Interactions: a '.wiggle' that on hover does translateY(-6px) rotate(-1deg) via transition cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1) over .35s; buttons hover:-translate-y-0.5. Use big blurred color blobs (w-72..w-96 sky/coral/sunny at 15-20% opacity, rounded-full, blur-3xl) floating behind the hero and the pricing banner. Icons are Phosphor (ph:*-fill and ph:*-bold) via Iconify. Keep copy warm and human, no em-dashes.

layout_and_structure.description: A full-width page in vertical sections, each section centered in a max-w-6xl container with 1.5rem horizontal padding. Vertical order: sticky glass nav -> centered hero (with two rotated floating sticker chips and blurred blobs) -> bento gallery (a md:grid-cols-3 row where card 1 spans 2 cols x 2 rows, plus a second md:grid-cols-4 row) -> a white 'How it works' band (a 3-up grid of numbered step cards) -> a 'Starter kits' section (a 2->4 col grid of gradient-header kit cards) -> a big ink-gradient rounded pricing/CTA banner -> footer. Responsive: the bento and most grids collapse to a single column on mobile; the gallery first row is 1 col on mobile and 3 cols at md (the feature card spanning 2x2); the second bento row is 1 col on mobile and 4 cols at md (the ink CTA tile spanning 2); the kits grid is 2 cols on mobile and 4 at md; nav center links hide below md; the floating sticker chips hide below lg.

prompts.prompt: A sticky top-0 z-50 header with bg-cream/85 + backdrop-blur-md and a bottom border at ink/5. Inside, a max-w-6xl row, h-[72px], items center, space-between, px-6. Left: a brand lockup, a 9x9 rounded-xl bg-ink tile with a shadow-soft holding a sunny ph:stack-fill glyph (text-xl), then a 19px font-extrabold tracking-tight 'Cardstack' wordmark. Center: a hidden md:flex nav of 15px font-medium ink/80 links (Gallery, How it works, Kits, Pricing), gap-8, hover:text-ink. Right: a hidden sm:inline 15px font-semibold ink/80 'Sign in' link, then a rounded-full bg-ink text-cream 'Start free' button (15px font-semibold, px-5 py-2.5, shadow-soft, with a sunny ph:arrow-up-right-bold, hover:-translate-y-0.5).

A relative overflow-hidden section with the '.grain' texture. Two absolute blurred blobs: a -top-24 -left-24 w-96 h-96 bg-sky/20 rounded-full blur-3xl and a -top-10 right-0 w-80 h-80 bg-coral/15 rounded-full blur-3xl. Two hidden lg:block floating 'sticker' chips: LEFT a top-28 left-10 rotate-[-8deg] bg-white shadow-lift rounded-2xl px-4 py-3 border border-ink/5 holding an 8x8 rounded-xl bg-coralDeep/15 ph:palette-fill (coralDeep) tile beside a 'Pastel' / 'palette' two-line label; RIGHT a top-44 right-12 rotate-[7deg] bg-ink text-cream shadow-lift rounded-2xl px-4 py-3 holding a sunny ph:lightning-fill icon beside a '3s' / 'to render' two-line label. Center content (max-w-6xl, px-6, pt-20 pb-12, text-center): a rounded-full bg-white border border-ink/10 shadow-soft pill (13px font-semibold) with a sunny ph 'NEW' badge (bg-sunny text-ink 11px font-bold rounded-full) then '900+ card layouts, prompt-ready'; an h1 in 44px -> sm:60px font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-[1.02] max-w-3xl mx-auto reading 'Beautiful cards,' (line break) 'snapped into place', where 'snapped into place' is wrapped in a relative inline-block with an absolute sunny/70 highlighter bar (h-3.5 w-full rounded-sm at bottom-1.5, -z-0) behind it; an 18px leading-relaxed ink/80 max-w-xl subhead ('A playful library of bento card designs you can describe in plain words. Drop a prompt, get a polished card kit ready to ship.'); and a centered wrap row of two CTAs: a rounded-full bg-coral text-white 'Browse the gallery' button (16px font-semibold, px-7 py-3.5, shadow-lift, ph:squares-four-bold, hover:-translate-y-0.5) and a rounded-full bg-white border border-ink/10 'See it work' button (16px font-semibold ink, px-7 py-3.5, shadow-soft, with a sky ph:play-circle-fill, hover:-translate-y-0.5).

A max-w-6xl section (id=gallery, px-6, pb-20 pt-4). FIRST ROW: a grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-5 auto-rows. CARD 1 (the big feature, md:col-span-2 md:row-span-2): a .wiggle rounded-[28px] p-8/sm:p-10 article with a bg-gradient-to-br from-skyDeep to-#065d91 text-white shadow-lift, relative overflow-hidden flex flex-col; an absolute -bottom-16 -right-12 w-64 h-64 bg-white/10 rounded-full decoration; an absolute top-8 right-8 12x12 rounded-2xl bg-white/20 ph:sparkle-fill tile; a w-fit bg-ink/30 'Featured kit' pill with a sunny ph:cards-three-fill; an h2 in 30px -> sm:38px font-extrabold leading-[1.08] max-w-md 'Bento dashboards, generated in seconds'; a 16px leading-relaxed body line; then a mini bento preview, a grid grid-cols-3 gap-2.5: a col-span-2 rounded-2xl bg-white/15 backdrop-blur h-24 chart tile (a ph:chart-bar-fill icon over a row of 5 rounded bar columns at varying heights, one bar bg-sunny), a rounded-2xl bg-sunny text-ink stat tile (a ph:arrow-up-right-bold over a 20px extrabold '+38%'), a rounded-2xl bg-coral text-white tile (a ph:star-fill + 'Rated 4.9'), and a col-span-2 rounded-2xl bg-white/15 label strip ('Quote · stat · chart · pricing' + a ph:dots-three-bold). CARD 2 (sunny stat): a .wiggle rounded-[28px] p-7 bg-sunny text-ink shadow-soft card, a ph:trend-up-bold (26px ink/80), a 44px font-extrabold leading-none tracking-tight '25,000+', a 15px font-semibold ink/80 caption 'makers shipping cards every month', and an avatar stack (four -space-x-2 8x8 rounded-full chips border-2 border-sunny in coral / sky / ink / white, the last a '+9k' label). CARD 3 (coral quote): a .wiggle rounded-[28px] p-7 bg-coralDeep text-white shadow-soft flex-col card, a 40px ph:quotes-fill (white/55), a 16px font-semibold leading-snug pull-quote, and a mt-auto author row (a 9x9 rounded-full bg-white/25 ph:user-fill avatar beside a 'Mara V.' / 'Product designer' label). SECOND ROW: a grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-4 gap-5 mt-5: two white mini-stat cards (.wiggle rounded-[28px] p-6 bg-white border border-ink/8 shadow-soft, each a 10x10 rounded-xl tinted icon tile, then a 30px font-extrabold number and a 14px ink/80 caption: a sky ph:lightning-fill '3s average generation', and a coral ph:palette-fill '48 palette presets'); and a wide ink CTA tile (md:col-span-2 .wiggle rounded-[28px] p-7 bg-ink text-cream shadow-lift relative overflow-hidden flex items-center justify-between, with an absolute -right-8 -top-8 w-40 h-40 bg-sunny/15 rounded-full blur-2xl, a 'Start your first stack' 20px extrabold heading + a 14px cream/80 line, and a shrink-0 rounded-full bg-sunny text-ink 'Go' button with a ph:arrow-right-bold).

A bg-white border-y border-ink/5 section (id=how). Inside, a max-w-6xl, px-6, py-20. A centered max-w-xl header: a skyDeep 13px font-bold tracking-[0.18em] uppercase eyebrow 'How it works', a 34px -> sm:42px font-extrabold tracking-tight 'From a sentence to a stack', and a 17px ink/80 line 'Three steps, zero design files. Describe, tweak, ship.'. Then a mt-12 grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 gap-5 of three .wiggle rounded-[28px] p-8 bg-cream border border-ink/8 shadow-soft text-center step cards, each a 14x14 mx-auto rounded-2xl tinted icon tile (a 3xl Phosphor glyph), a colored extrabold step number ('01' skyDeep, '02' coralDeep, '03' amberInk), a 20px font-bold title, and a 15px ink/80 body: 01 Describe it (sky/15 ph:chat-circle-text-fill), 02 Tune the vibe (coral/15 ph:sliders-horizontal-fill), 03 Ship the stack (sunny/25 ph:export-fill amberInk).

A max-w-6xl section (id=kits, px-6, py-20). A flex-col sm:flex-row sm:items-end justify-between header: a block with a coralDeep 13px font-bold tracking-[0.18em] uppercase eyebrow 'Starter kits' and a 34px -> sm:42px font-extrabold tracking-tight 'Pick a mood, start stacking', plus a w-fit 'All 36 kits' link with a ph:arrow-right-bold. Then a grid grid-cols-2 md:grid-cols-4 gap-5 of four .wiggle rounded-[28px] overflow-hidden bg-white border border-ink/8 shadow-soft kit cards, each an h-28 gradient header centered around a 4xl Phosphor glyph plus a p-5 footer with a 16px font-bold title and a 13px ink/75 meta line: Sky Bento (from-skyDeep to-#065d91, white ph:squares-four-fill, '12 cards · cool & calm'), Coral Pop (from-coralDeep to-#b82a44, white ph:heart-fill, '10 cards · warm & bold'), Sunny Day (from-sunny to-#f59e0b, ink ph:sun-fill, '14 cards · cheerful'), Ink Mode (from-ink to-#473d5c, sunny ph:moon-stars-fill, '11 cards · dark & crisp').

prompts.prompt: PRICING (id=pricing): a max-w-6xl, px-6, pb-24, holding one rounded-[36px] bg-gradient-to-br from-ink to-#3a3150 text-cream banner with p-10/sm:p-16, text-center, relative overflow-hidden and the '.grain' texture, plus two blurred blobs (a -top-16 -left-10 w-72 h-72 bg-sky/20 and a -bottom-20 -right-10 w-80 h-80 bg-coral/20, both rounded-full blur-3xl). Inside: a bg-white/10 border border-white/15 rounded-full pill ('Free to start, $12/mo to go pro' with a sunny ph:sparkle-fill), a 36px -> sm:50px font-extrabold tracking-tight leading-[1.05] max-w-2xl 'Your next card kit is one prompt away', an 18px cream/70 max-w-xl line, and a centered wrap CTA row: a rounded-full bg-sunny text-ink 'Start free' button (16px font-bold, px-8 py-4, shadow-lift, ph:arrow-up-right-bold) and a rounded-full bg-white/10 border border-white/20 text-cream 'Talk to us' button. FOOTER: a border-t border-ink/8 footer, a max-w-6xl py-12 flex-col sm:flex-row items-center justify-between row: the brand lockup (an 8x8 rounded-lg bg-ink ph:stack-fill sunny tile + a 17px extrabold 'Cardstack'), a wrap nav of five 14px font-medium ink/75 links (Gallery, Kits, Pricing, Docs, Changelog), and a row of three ink/50 social icons (ph:x-logo-fill, ph:github-logo-fill, ph:dribbble-logo-fill); below, a centered 13px ink/40 line '© 2026 Cardstack. Made for makers who love a tidy grid.'

special_ui_components.prompt: Bento card grid: a mixed-span CSS grid of very-rounded (rounded-[28px]) cards where a large feature card spans 2 columns x 2 rows and smaller stat / quote / CTA / mini-stat cards fill the rest across two rows (a 3-col row then a 4-col row), each card a different solid color, gradient, or white surface.

Big feature 'kit' card: a deep-sky gradient (from-skyDeep to-#065d91) tile with a 'Featured kit' pill, a big extrabold heading, body copy, a corner sparkle tile, a soft white/10 blob, and a nested mini-bento preview (a glass bar-chart tile + a sunny +38% stat tile + a coral rating tile + a label strip).

Mini bento preview: a 3-column nested grid inside the feature card built from translucent bg-white/15 backdrop-blur tiles and solid sunny / coral tiles, including a tiny inline bar chart (rounded column bars at varying heights with one sunny bar).

Floating 'sticker' chips: small rotated (rotate-[-8deg] / rotate-[7deg]) rounded-2xl shadow-lift chips floating absolutely in the hero (one white 'Pastel palette', one ink '3s to render'), each an icon tile beside a two-line micro label; hidden below lg.

Highlighter headline: a hand-drawn marker effect made by wrapping a headline phrase in a relative inline-block with an absolute sunny/70 bar (h-3.5, full width, rounded-sm, bottom-1.5, behind the text) so a key phrase looks swiped with a highlighter.
Wiggle hover: a '.wiggle' card interaction that on hover does translateY(-6px) rotate(-1deg) via a springy cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1) transition, giving the cards a playful tilt-and-lift.

Sunny stat card with avatar stack: a saturated bg-sunny card with a big extrabold number ('25,000+') and a row of overlapping -space-x-2 rounded-full avatar chips bordered in the card color, ending in a '+9k' chip.

Pill CTA system: full-rounded (rounded-full) buttons and chips throughout (bg-ink, bg-coral, bg-sunny, white-bordered, white/10 on dark) with leading/trailing Phosphor icons and a hover:-translate-y-0.5 lift; the dark mark on the nav button is an ink tile with a sunny glyph.

Gradient-header kit cards: white overflow-hidden cards whose top h-28 is a saturated bg-gradient-to-br header centered on a large Phosphor glyph (one per mood: sky / coral / sunny / ink), over a small title + 'N cards · mood' meta footer.

Ink-gradient CTA banner with blobs: a big rounded-[36px] bg-gradient-to-br from-ink to-#3a3150 banner carrying the dot grain plus two blurred sky/coral color blobs, a pill, a huge extrabold headline, and two pill CTAs.

structured.special_notes: Palette is a warm cream canvas (#fdf9f3) + a bright pastel accent quartet, sky (#38bdf8, deep #0876b8), coral/rose (#fb7185, deep #d83b56), sunny yellow (#ffc23c, with amber-ink #a86a00 for text on yellow), all anchored by a soft near-black plum 'ink' (#2a2438) for headings, the brand mark, dark cards, and dark bands. The whole page is built from big friendly rounded-[28px]/[36px] cards, full-pill buttons/chips, generous padding, and two soft layered shadows (soft 0 18px 40px -18px rgba(42,36,56,0.22), lift 0 26px 60px -22px rgba(42,36,56,0.30)). One typeface only, Poppins (400-800, via Google Fonts), with heavy extrabold (800) tracking-tight headings. The playful character comes from: a sunny/70 highlighter bar swiped behind a headline phrase, rotated floating 'sticker' chips in the hero, big blurred sky/coral/sunny color blobs behind blur-3xl, a faint dot 'grain' texture on the hero and CTA banner, and a springy '.wiggle' hover that tilts and lifts cards (translateY(-6px) rotate(-1deg), cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1)). The signature surface is the bento grid: a mixed-span layout where a 2x2 deep-sky gradient feature card (with a nested mini-bento preview) anchors a field of sunny stat, coral quote, white mini-stat, and ink CTA cards. Icons are Phosphor (ph:*-fill / -bold) via Iconify. Copy is warm and human with zero em-dashes ('Beautiful cards, snapped into place', 'From a sentence to a stack', 'Pick a mood, start stacking', 'Made for makers who love a tidy grid.'). All numbers / names / quotes are sample copy so the prompt ships with no bundled assets; the reusable value is the playful pastel bento card system (mixed-span rounded cards, the highlighter headline, sticker chips, color blobs, and the wiggle hover), not the words.
